# Locally bundled PDF.js

Mozilla PDF.js / pdfjs-dist version **6.5.438**, Apache 2.0.
Source: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
Distribution: https://registry.npmjs.org/pdfjs-dist/-/pdfjs-dist-6.5.438.tgz
The downloaded archive was verified against the registry's SHA-512 integrity value.

Included: minified renderer and matching worker, official viewer CSS, CMaps,
standard fonts, image-decoding WASM resources, and the original LICENSE.
All resources are served locally. Keep renderer, worker and resources on the same
version when updating. Run the JavaScript and real-browser PDF checks afterward.
